title: Important Update: CBDT Notifies Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026
content:
# Important Update: CBDT Notifies Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026

Ek important update hai for all CAs and tax professionals! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026 announce kiya hai, vide Notification No. 120/2026 dated September 17, 2026. This notification brings several significant changes, especially concerning deadlines and recovery procedures.

Here are the key highlights from the amendment:

*   **Extension of Deadlines:** The due date for registration under Rule 246(4) (for valuers) and Rule 256(4) (for authorised income-tax practitioners) has been extended.
    *   **Old Due Date:** September 30, 2026
    *   **New Due Date:** March 31, 2027
*   **Removal of Arrest and Detention:** In a significant procedural change, the provisions for arrest and detention as modes of tax recovery under Rule 225 of the Income-tax Rules, 2026, have been omitted. This means a shift towards other recovery methods like attachment and sale of property.
*   **Broadening Electronic Communication:** Rule 176(3)(a)(ii) now allows for authentication of electronic records "by way of an electronic communication" instead of strictly "by affixing digital signature," promoting a more technology-neutral approach.
*   **Revised Application Forms:** Form No. 169 (for application for registration as a valuer) and Form No. 171 (for application for registration as an authorised income-tax practitioner) have been substituted with updated requirements and details.
*   **Commencement:** Rules 2 to 4 of these amendment rules are deemed to have come into force retrospectively from April 1, 2026, while Rules 5 to 8 are effective from September 17, 2026, the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.
